rotasutils.msg.rift_sigil.no_room: No room for a rift there. Look at open ground.
item.rotasutils.prism_sigil.desc: The sky tears open in every colour at once.
item.rotasutils.radiant_rift.desc: A colossal prismatic hand reaches out and strikes.
item.rotasutils.rift.arrival.desc: Opens a rift a traveller steps out of.
item.rotasutils.rift.travel.desc: Sneak + use: bind where the rift leads. Use: open it.
item.rotasutils.rift.maw.desc: Opens a rift that drags nearby monsters in and swallows them.
item.rotasutils.rift.tentacle.desc: Opens a rift whose tentacles strike nearby monsters.
rotasutils.msg.rift_key.unbound: The key leads nowhere yet. Sneak and use it where the rift should lead.
item.rotasutils.convergence_sigil.desc: Four rifts clash, and something steps out.
item.rotasutils.sky_clash_sigil.desc: Tears the four rifts open in the sky and sets them against each other.
rotasutils.msg.sky_clash.no_sky: There is no sky here to tear.
rotasutils.msg.sky_clash.running: The heavens are already at war.
item.rotasutils.sundering_sigil.desc: Binds the open rift in a golden seal and shatters it, closing the sky.
rotasutils.msg.sundering_sigil.no_rift: There is no rift in this sky to break.
rotasutils.msg.convergence.no_room: Four rifts need open, level ground around a clear centre.
rotasutils.tetrarch.branded: You are branded. Get far from where you stand!
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.arrive: Four heavens I have crossed. Kneel, or be unmade.
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.phase2: You wound a sovereign? Then meet my reflections.
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.phase3: Enough. Let every rift open at once.
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.enrage: I will not be ended by the likes of you!
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.convergence: Find the one road that does not burn.
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.wheel: The four heavens turn as one. Keep pace, or be cut.
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.ascend: Behold the throne of the four heavens, and fall with it.
rotasutils.tetrarch.say.death: The rifts... close... but they will open again.
item.rotasutils.red_reversal.desc: Right click: a slow, deliberate charge and one violent release.
item.rotasutils.red_reversal_max.desc: Right click: a block of pressure crushed to a point, then let go all at once. It hits twice.
item.rotasutils.zenith.desc: Every blade that came before, forged into one.
item.rotasutils.zenith.use: Hold use to loose spectral copies of every sword in the world
item.rotasutils.exo_disintegrator.desc: Exo-grade power, focused into a single unmaking ray.
item.rotasutils.exo_disintegrator.use: Hold use to charge, then channel a piercing ray. Overheats after 10 seconds
item.rotasutils.exo_disintegrator.lance: Sneak and use to fire the Annihilation Lance: one overcharged discharge, twice as wide
item.rotasutils.exo_disintegrator.cero: Sneak and left-click to loose the Cero Metralleta: a five-second azure torrent that sets everything it sweeps alight
item.rotasutils.zenith.excalibur: Sneak + use: Excalibur, a colossal slash of light
spell.rotasutils.astral_bolt.guide: Fling a white-hot shard of starlight that bursts on whatever it strikes.
spell.rotasutils.nova_burst.guide: Release a ring of starfire around you, hurting and hurling back every enemy nearby.
spell.rotasutils.prism_ray.guide: Channel a rainbow beam of split starlight that pierces every enemy in its path.
spell.rotasutils.starlance_volley.guide: Summon a rack of spectral lances behind you and hurl them in arcs onto your target.
spell.rotasutils.comet_dash.guide: Become a comet: surge forward, blazing through and knocking aside everything in your way.
spell.rotasutils.constellation_bind.guid: Draw a star sigil on the ground. Enemies inside are pinned in place as stars, joined by light.
spell.rotasutils.aurora_ward.guide: Wrap yourself in turning rings of aurora that absorb harm and knit wounds.
spell.rotasutils.supernova.guide: Gather a star in your hands, then detonate it where you aim in a dome of blinding light.
death.attack.abyss_magic.player: %1$s was swallowed by the abyss of %2$s
spell.rotasutils.shadow_bolt.guide: Loose a living eel of ink. It swims to its prey, coils around it and bursts, raining ink that stains the ground.
spell.rotasutils.umbral_grasp.guide: Spill a pool of liquid night. Hands rise from it and close around every creature standing in it.
spell.rotasutils.void_ray.guide: Channel a beam of anti-light that withers everything it passes through.
spell.rotasutils.eclipse_nova.guide: A great eye opens above you, hunts your foes, and blinks - darkness rolls out with the blink.
spell.rotasutils.shade_step.guide: Dissolve into shadow and reform ahead, striking whoever waits there.
spell.rotasutils.abyssal_pit.guide: A fanged mouth opens in the ground. Its tongues drag enemies in, and at the end it bites shut.
spell.rotasutils.night_veil.guide: Wrap yourself in night: invisible, swift, and forgotten by the creatures hunting you.
spell.rotasutils.oblivion.guide: Gather the dark into a sphere that swallows the light, then let it burst into oblivion.

skill.rotasutils.exo_overdrive.tooltip: Brace, shoulder the Disintegrator and overcharge it: after a moment the Annihilation Lance fires regardless of cooldown, and the muzzle blast hurls back everything in front of you.
skill.rotasutils.momentum.tooltip: Hits on the same enemy within 3 seconds build Momentum: +%s%% damage per stack, up to %s stacks. The hit after a full set is a Crescendo that deals %s%% more damage and restores %s stamina. Getting hurt loses 2 stacks.
skill.rotasutils.last_bastion.tooltip: Below %s%% health, damage you take is reduced by %s%% and every hit restores stamina. Once every %s seconds, a blow that would kill you leaves you at 1 health with Absorption and Resistance.
skill.rotasutils.predators_mark.tooltip: Striking an enemy from behind, or one hunting someone else, deals %s%% more damage and marks it. Killing a marked enemy within %s seconds makes you vanish: brief invisibility, speed and stamina.
skill.rotasutils.afterimage.tooltip: A successful dodge leaves an afterimage. Your next attack within %s seconds deals %s%% more damage and restores %s stamina.
skill.rotasutils.arcane_edge.tooltip: Every %s melee hits, your strike resonates: enemies near the target take %s%% of the hit as magic damage within %s blocks. Scales with Iron's Spells spell power.
skill.rotasutils.hunters_patience.toolti: Stand still for %s seconds to gain Focus: your next projectile hit deals %s%% more damage. Every projectile also gains %s%% damage per block beyond 10 blocks, up to %s%%.
